display_name: Advanced Kinetic Typography 高级动态文字

presets.name: 液态金属流动
presets.description: 文字表面呈现液态金属流动效果，结合湍流置换+金属渐变+高光扫描，对标Vimeo顶级motion graphics
presets.jsx_template: (function(){var _r={};try{var c=app.project.activeItem;if(!c||!(c instanceof CompItem)){_r={status:'error',message:'No active comp'};return JSON.stringify(_r);}var n='{{textLayerName}}';var L=null;for(var i=1;i<=c.numLayers;i++){if(c.layer(i).name==n){L=c.layer(i);break;}}if(!L||!(L instanceof TextLayer)){_r={status:'error',message:'Text layer not found:
